summary.name: Lapce
summary.one_liner: Lapce is an open-source, Rust-based code editor with a native GPU-accelerated GUI, built-in LSP and Tree-sitter highlighting, and remote development support.
use_cases: developing on a remote machine with local-like experience
running a terminal inside the editor at the workspace path
writing editor plugins in any WASI-compiling language
summary.what_it_does: Lapce is a code editor built with Rust and a native GUI that uses GPU acceleration through the Floem framework. It uses Tree-sitter for syntax highlighting and has built-in LSP support for code completion, diagnostics, and code actions. It offers a Vim-like editing mode without needing a plugin. Users can connect to remote machines and work with a local-feeling experience, and can start a terminal at their workspace path inside the editor. Plugins can be written in any language that compiles to WASI.
notable: Native GUI with GPU acceleration via Floem, built in Rust
Built-in Vim-like editing mode without a plugin
Plugins can be written in any language that compiles to WASI
Remote development with Lapdev for managing remote dev environments
caveats: Page lists a .dmg download, suggesting macOS; other platforms are not named on the page
Lapdev is referenced for managing remote environments but no details are given
